mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-rate periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 6.0% (UNRATE < 6.0%) signals a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE < 6.0%, 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous expansion in the labor market (PAYEMS rising) and consumer spending (RSAFS rising) indicates robust economic growth, which supports equity valuations and drives positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: When both PAYEMS and RSAFS rise, 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%), a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals monetary tightening that reduces equity valuations, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%), 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises by more than 0.1% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in industrial production above 105.0 (INDPRO > 105.0) signals robust manufacturing activity and strong economic growth, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: In periods where INDPRO > 105.0, 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A housing market expansion above 900.0 thousand units (HOUST > 900.0) signals strong consumer confidence and increased construction activity, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: In periods where HOUST > 900.0, 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 > 2.0% annualized) signals a healthy economy that supports corporate earnings, leading to positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in strong GDP growth periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous expansion in employment (PAYEMS rising) and housing starts (HOUST rising) indicates a virtuous cycle of rising consumer confidence and spending, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: When both PAYEMS and HOUST rise, 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances.
